{{Quote|And you, young lady&hellip;Beware of older military officers who chase you when you're a teenager. They'll just dump you when you turn thirty.''"<br />"''Dad, I hate it when you bring work home.|Garik Loran to Adra Passik|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
'''Adra Passik''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the daughter of former [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Dia Passik]]. After Dia [[Wedding of Garik Loran and Dia Passik|married]] fellow Wraith [[Garik Loran|Garik "Face" Loran]], Face adopted Adra as his daughter.
